737:t_004:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「What do you intend to do!?」

737:t_004:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「I'm doing it! I'll seal him away with the dimensional barrier at full strength!」

737:t_004:6.en:
$$エスター$$
「$$Ｚクリスタル$$! Answer everyone's feelings!」

737:t_016:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「With the power of our feelings, we'll seal your divine power!」

737:t_016:2.en:
$$葵$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! This is where you end!」

737:t_016:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Impossible! Me... I, an $$御使い$$...!」

737:t_016:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「There's no such thing as absolute in this world!」

737:t_016:5.en:
$$竜馬$$
「The time has come for you to pay the price for everything you've done over 120 million years!」

737:t_017:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I... I am...! I am...aaaaaaah!!」

737:t_018:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「I sealed him inside the dimensional barrier. He can't come back anymore.」

737:t_005:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「To think you would be bested by mere humans.」

737:t_006:0.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「I can't believe it...! $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ lost!?」

737:t_006:1.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「It has been a mere 12,000 years since we last saw him. If his power has waned, it must be because his heart grew complacent.」

737:t_006:2.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Well, he was driven from the ranks of the $$御使い$$s, after all. That's about what you'd expect.」

737:t_006:3.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Even so, we must avenge him, if only to show the Earthlings the power of the $$御使い$$s.」

737:t_006:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「You're awfully gentle with the guy who killed your comrade!」

737:t_006:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Isn't $$サクリファイ$$ your comrade!?」

737:t_006:7.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You're saying $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ killed $$サクリファイ$$?」

737:t_006:8.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Nonsense. Do you think we, the servants of the Supreme God, would be shaken by a lie like that?」

737:t_006:9.en:
$$タケル$$
「It's not a lie! He killed $$サクリファイ$$...!」

737:t_007:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Filthy $$バアル$$! To cover up your own deeds, you would pin the blame on $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, our comrade!」

737:t_007:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Too bad for you! $$テンプティ$$ and the others are $$御使い$$s... beings completely freed from every conflict and every lie!」

737:t_007:3.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Damn $$バアル$$! Not content with invading $$カオス・コスモス$$, you even defile our $$エス・テラン$$!」

737:t_007:4.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Wait a second! Is that $$バアル$$ thing talking about us!?」

737:t_007:6.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Incarnations of boundless destruction, servants of the force that seeks to vanish... You who wiped them out are the true $$バアル$$!」

737:t_007:7.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「No... not only you! In these 120 million years, the universe has become an evil world overrun with $$バアル$$!」

737:t_007:8.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What kind of logic is that!」

737:t_007:9.en:
$$シン$$
「Is that how you've been destroying galaxies, by making up accusations against them!?」

737:t_007:10.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「They're not made-up accusations! Because that is the truth!」

737:t_007:11.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Very well! We shall show you our power once more!」

737:t_008:1.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Confirmed: the Cartwheel Galaxy of the 41st World has vanished.」

737:t_008:2.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Next is the Yugtos Galaxy of the 6th World!」

737:t_009:2.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「How funny! Why are you so angry just because some galaxies that have nothing to do with you got destroyed?」

737:t_009:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Then allow me to ask! You are the administrators of all the parallel worlds, so why do you do such a thing!?」

737:t_009:4.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Because that is our duty... the duty of the $$御使い$$s!」

737:t_009:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Who asked you to do that!」

737:t_009:6.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「A mission is not something given by another! It is something one imposes upon oneself!」

737:t_009:7.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「To guide every universe rightly, we condemn sin! That is the one and only absolute way to save the universe from collapse!」

737:t_009:8.en:
$$赤木$$
「There's something wrong with you people!」

737:t_009:9.en:
$$レド$$
「These guys are the same as that $$ストライカー#robot$$! They intend to eliminate everything except the righteousness they decided on themselves!」

737:t_009:11.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Looks like you acknowledged the power of $$テンプティ$$ and the others, and now you're scared.」

737:t_009:12.en:
$n
「Shut up. You devil who takes pleasure in other people's misery.」

737:t_009:14.en:
$n
「Let me put it so even that empty head of yours can understand. I have no intention of entertaining you people, not even a little.」

737:t_009:16.en:
$$アルト$$
「I thought I'd talk with you too, to prevent the great collapse of the universe, but it looks like that was pointless as well!」

737:t_009:17.en:
$$宗介$$
「There can be no reconciliation in our showdown with you!」

737:t_009:18.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Fools! That is exactly why we call you $$バアル$$!」

737:t_009:19.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Which is why we will purge you and stop the great collapse of the universe!」

737:t_009:20.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「For us, who have lost $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, that is the only means left!」

737:t_009:21.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「So if we disappear, the great collapse will stop!?」

737:t_009:22.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You finally get it! And you still intend to come at us!?」

737:t_009:23.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Or is it that? As long as your own puny pride is satisfied, you don't care what happens to the universe?」

737:t_009:24.en:
$n
「You still don't get it! You people...!」

737:t_009:25.en:
$$ランド$$
「Drop it, $n! It's pointless to say anything to these guys!」

737:t_009:26.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Now I get why $$ヴィルダーク$$ and $$アサキム$$ sought power at any cost.」

737:t_009:27.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Words don't reach these people...! That's why!」

737:t_009:28.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Come, evil seed! We shall strike down the $$バアル$$ that bring the universe to collapse!」

737:t_009:29.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Don't worry. You can leave what comes after to $$テンプティ$$ and the others.」

737:t_009:30.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「By relying on the existence of an unseen God, waiting for humanity's voluntary $$シンカ$$ did nothing but breed harm!」

737:t_009:31.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「When peace comes to the universe, we will descend upon every parallel world and manage humanity's evolution directly!」

737:t_009:32.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That arrogance...! As I thought, you are the fundamental calamity!」

737:t_009:33.en:
$$シモン$$
「Then we'll punch through you and keep going!」

737:t_009:34.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't think you can stop our evolution... our very living... with your own selfish logic!」
